subject: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation playbook — confirm owners and target dates
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ali <samir.ali@quantix.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@quantix.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + Mutual Action Plan (next steps & owners)
Attachments: Quantix_MAP_v3.pdf (application/pdf), redwood_eval_playbook.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap and the MAP I promised is attached. I pulled together a lightweight evaluation playbook as well (spreadsheet) that maps out tasks, recommended owners, and proposed dates so we can keep momentum.

High-level recap:
- Goal: Proof-of-concept to validate LLM-driven document parsing for structured-data extraction across 3 finance templates.
- Success criteria: 90% field extraction accuracy on KPI set A, end-to-end latency <250ms p50 for 2k tokens, and cost target under $X/token.
- Constraints: Data residency in US, PII redaction required for logs.

Suggested next steps (in MAP):
1) Confirm internal owners & sign-offs (who will run the POC on your side?) — action: Quantix to confirm names
2) Environment prep & test data delivery — action: Quantix + Redwood (support)
3) 2-week evaluation run w/ weekly checkpoints (start date TBD) — action: both parties

Can you please confirm who from Quantix will own each row in the MAP and whether the proposed 2-week window after environment prep still looks reasonable? If helpful, I can lock a kickoff date for the week of June 28.

Thanks — I’m copying Rachel (solutions lead) to help with the technical checklist and Aditya (procurement) for any commercial/PO questions.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Rachel / Aditya —

Looping you in on the MAP I sent to Quantix. No reply yet (bumped once). If it helps our cadence, here are my recommended owners on the Redwood side:
- Technical onboarding & data ingestion: Rachel Kim
- Evaluation configs & monitoring: Rachel + Solutions Eng team
- Commercial / PO: Aditya Rao (will shepherd PO + SOW)

If you want to pre-fill any of the MAP rows or draft a short kickoff agenda I can include when we lock a date. I’d like to keep the POC tight (2 weeks of run) and isolate scope to 3 templates to avoid scope creep.

Thanks — Tessa

Hi Tessa —

Apologies for the delay — been pulling in folks on our end. Quick answers:
- Owners: Priya Shah will be the POC / project owner for the evaluation. She’ll own data delivery and internal testing. I’ll be available as exec sponsor.
- Timeline: June 28 kickoff is tight for our legal/IT sign-offs. Would July 6 (week of) work instead for a 2-week run?
- Requirements: We need a short checklist for the environment prep (SFTP, sample data, VPN rules). Can Rachel send a one-pager we can share with IT?

We’ll review the attached MAP and send back updated owner names inline by EOD Wed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

—

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff. I’ll put a tentative 60-minute kickoff on July 6 and we can trim if needed.
